title: Caliburn GK3 Kit
description:
UWELL CALIBURN GK3 POD KIT

The UWELL CALIBURN GK3 POD KIT is a cutting-edge pod system designed for a futuristic vaping experience. The kit features a 2ml UWELL CALIBURN G3 REPLACEMENT POD with an integrated mesh coil, offering mouth-to-lung satisfaction and a rich taste. With a powerful 900mAh internal battery capable of delivering up to 25W output, this lightweight and compact device boasts a see-through case for a stylish look. The dual airflow system and full-width LCD display on the front enhance user convenience, providing information on power, resistance, battery capacity, and puff count. The UWELL CALIBURN GK3 POD KIT ensures a leakproof experience, improving flavor by 150%, and includes both 0.6ohm and 0.9ohm pods for versatile vaping straight out of the box. With a durable PCTG plastic construction, lanyard loop for portability, and Type-C charging for faster recharging, the UWELL CALIBURN GK3 POD KIT strikes the perfect balance between style, flavor, and convenience.

Features:

- Precise Power Adjustment

- Dual Airflow System

- Pro-FOCS Flavor Tech

- 2A Fast Charging

- Lanyard Loop

- Wider Clear View

Parameters:

- Materials: PCTG, PC+ABS

- Dimensions: 74.8 mm × 49.2 mm × 17.1 mm

- Net Weight: Approx. 52 g

- liquid Capacity:2ml

- Output Power: Maximum 25 W

- Battery Capacity: 900 mAh

Includes:
1 x UWELL CALIBURN GK3 POD KIT [CRC] Device
1 x UWELL CALIBURN G3 REPLACEMENT POD [CRC]- 0.6ohm
1 x UWELL CALIBURN G3 REPLACEMENT POD [CRC]-0.9ohm
1 x Type-C Charging Cable
1 x Lanyard
1 x User Manual
